title: Pic proper curve cokernel component
statement: Let C be a proper smooth connected dimension-one curve over an algebraically closed field k [def-sc-curves], with genus g [def-sc-genus], Picard group Pic(C) [def-sc-picard-group], and degree-zero subgroup Pic⁰(C) [def-sc-pic0]. Let n be a natural number whose image in k is nonzero. Then Pic(C) modulo the image of multiplication by n is isomorphic as a group to ℤ/nℤ.

proof.text: Use the Picard decomposition Pic(C) ≃ ℤ × P0 with underlying set of P0 equal to Pic⁰(C). The divisibility component makes the nth-power map on P0 surjective.

Map the integer coordinate modulo n. Integer cast is surjective (ZMod.intCast_surjective). The kernel is the nth-power image: n-th powers vanish modulo n; for the converse write the integer coordinate as n*z using ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd and take an nth root of the P0 coordinate. Apply the inverse decomposition. The first isomorphism theorem (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective), after changing the subgroup by equality, identifies the quotient with Multiplicative (ZMod n).

proof_origin.place: Blueprint Jacobian argument; second reading expands the full component proof and formalizes the cokernel calculation.

theorem Scheme.Hom.pic_proper_ntorsion_coker
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f]
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : (n : k) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (C.Pic ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : C.Pic →* C.Pic).range ≃*
      Multiplicative (ZMod n))
